name: Dismantling Joints
oneLineScope: Flanged dismantling joints with adjustment length for valve removal, 50 – 1,200 mm NB

types.name: Single-step
types.description: One adjustment sleeve for straightforward in-line valve removal.

types.name: Double-step
types.description: Two-stage adjustment for larger extraction distances.

types.name: Coupled type
types.description: Incorporates a sleeve coupling for pipe-length adjustment without flanges.

faqs.question: What is a dismantling joint?
faqs.answer: A dismantling joint is a flanged fitting with an adjustable length that allows valves, pumps and other in-line equipment to be removed for maintenance without cutting the pipe. The joint is compressed on installation and extended to create the clearance needed for removal.

faqs.question: What adjustment length is available?
faqs.answer: Adjustment length data are pending confirmation from engineering. Precise Engineers sizes the dismantling joint to match the face-to-face dimension of the valve or equipment it serves.

faqs.question: Which flange standards do dismantling joints suit?
faqs.answer: Dismantling joints are available drilled to ANSI B16.1, BS 4504 (EN 1092) and DIN 2501 flanges. Mixed drilling is available on request.

faqs.question: What seal materials are available?
faqs.answer: EPDM for water and mild chemicals, NBR for oil-containing services and Neoprene for weather-exposed installations. The seal grade is selected to suit the medium and operating temperature.

faqs.question: What pressure ratings are offered?
faqs.answer: Pressure capability data are pending from engineering. Precise Engineers is ISO 9001:2015 certified and EIL approved, supplying dismantling joints to water utilities, pumping stations and process plant across India.
